title: the whole, and a page for each place ({count})
query:
SELECT path, looks, scale, of_thing, says, title FROM (
  SELECT 'fulldome.html' AS path, 'face' AS looks, 'every place observed' AS scale, '' AS of_thing,
         'Each star of the open commons: why it exists and how far it has come - then what is still showing, and every lens over every place observed.' AS says,
         '' AS title
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'places/' || place || '.html', 'around@' || id, 'a place', id, coalesce(says, ''), star
  FROM things WHERE of_table = 'places'
) ORDER BY path

SELECT star, says, done, items FROM (
  SELECT star, 0 AS rung, seq, CASE WHEN length("text") > 240 THEN left("text", 240) || '...' ELSE "text" END AS says,
         NULL AS done, NULL AS items
  FROM idea WHERE kind = 'lead'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT star, rung, seq, title || ' (rung ' || rung || ')', done, items FROM rests WHERE items > 0
) ORDER BY star, rung, seq
title: {star}
how work is done here ({count})
query: SELECT id, left(coalesce(practice, name || ': ' || description), 170) AS said FROM practices ORDER BY star, id

title: shown in what was decided or said ({count})
query:
SELECT e.from_id AS practice, e.to_star || '/' || e.to_table || ':' || e.to_id AS thing, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says
FROM edges e LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e."to" WHERE e.how = 'shown_in' AND e.from_table = 'practices' ORDER BY e.from_id, thing

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM practices) AS practices,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT "from") FROM edges WHERE how = 'shown_in' AND from_table = 'practices') AS shown
lays_out: {practices} practices; {shown} say where they are shown
